images.title: A line past one
images.purpose: Pose the question: a line from 0 ends halfway between 1 and 2 on a number line cut into halves; the student counts every half from 0 to find its length.
images.composition: One long number line near the bottom, a short given line just above it and a longer line above that, both starting at 0, with open space around them.
images.exact_structure: A grey #6B7280 number line from 0 to 2 with exactly 5 evenly spaced ticks: each unit cut into 2 equal parts. Just above it, a thick teal #0072B2 line from 0 to the 1st tick, labelled 1/2 above its end. Higher up, a thick amber #E69F00 line starting exactly above 0 and ending exactly above the tick halfway between 1 and 2, with a reddish purple #CC79A7 question label at its end. Exactly 1 number line, 2 lines.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any length, fraction or counting mark written on the amber line
images.takeaway: Count every part of 1/2 from 0 to the end of the line, even past 1.
images.description: A number line from 0 to 2 in halves; a teal line from 0 is labelled 1/2, and an amber line from 0 ends halfway between 1 and 2 with the question how long.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to start at 0 and count how many teal lengths fit under the amber line.

image_decisions.why: The given half and the longer line on one number line set up the counting without showing the length.
